name: Apatura
ownership_summary: Energy and data centre developer; Companies House shows a group including APATURA LTD, APATURA DC LTD and numbered SPVs APATURA DC PROJECT 1-12 LTD. Which entity (if any numbered SPV) fronts Haspielaw is unconfirmed.
notes: Attribution to Apatura rests on Foxglove, APRS and press listings plus the P/25/0490 agent address (1 Bar Lane, York YO1 6JU) matching Apatura's York office; the applicant name is not exposed by the PlanIt mirror and the council portal was unreachable.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: Lists Haspielaw (Hamilton) on its Scotland data centre map and characterises it as a hyperscale proposal on green belt farmland; monitoring/opposition stance rather than a site-specific local campaign.

name: Foxglove
notes: Included Haspielaw Farm in its December 2025 briefing on planned Scottish data centres' electricity demand, applying a 250MW working estimate in the absence of a developer figure.
